en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Muhammad Bin Ali, from Abdul Rahman Bin Muhammad Bin Abu Hashim, from Anbasa Al Aabid, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Loves the servant that he seeks (Forgiveness) to Him<sup>azwj</sup> regarding the grievous crime and He<sup>azwj</sup> Hates the servant if he takes lightly with the small crime’.
en.sarwar: 6. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid from Muhammad ibn Ali from ‘Abd al-Rahman ibn Muhammad ibn abu Hashim from ‘Anbasah al-‘Abid from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) has said, ‘
Allah loves that a servant asks Him for help in great crimes and He hates the servant who considers trivial sins insignificant.’”
